title: 62,500 Fama food kits for disaster victims | The Star
text:
62,500 Fama food kits for disaster victims | The Star
TANJONG KARANG: A total of 62,500 food kits will be supplied to the National Disaster Management Agency (Nadma) for distribution to victims of disasters, especially floods, across the country.
The Agriculture and Food Industries Ministry, through the Federal Agricultural Marketing Authority (Fama), is the supplier.
